changelog: Added Jarvis: hands-free voice control of the whole app, with tasks, voice approvals and a wake phrase
Added Server mode: run the agents on your own server (VPS/PC) and use AntiGem as the app for it
Added X11 Desktop: run a Linux desktop (XFCE or LXQt) and GUI apps with Termux:X11 (Shared UID build)
Added github integration: clone, pull, push and manage your repositories from the app
Added Termux Support in Settings: Termux:API and X11 Desktop in one place
Added a theme gallery and a quick theme picker in the sidebar
Added better file explorer with a new file picker and a new file viewer
Added a What's new page with the changes of every version (Settings → About & Info)
And redesigned the app to be more user-friendly and intuitive
